html: † דְּיוֹ n.m. ink (NH id., Aramaic דְּיוּתָא, ܕܝܽܘܬܳܐ; Arabic دَوَاةٌ inkbottle, inkhorn; Ges-Dietr Fl NHWB i. 41 der. from √ דוה in assumed sense of slowly flowing; Fl comp. Arabic دُواية, دِواية thin skin on surface of milk, cf. also Ol§ 173 g), וַאֲנִי כֹּתֵב עַל־הַסֵּפֶר בַּדְּי֑וֹ Je 36:18, cf. Lag Ges. Abh. 216.—On erasible quality of Hebrew ink cf. RSOTJC, 400 f. ed. 2, 71; v. further L. LöwGraphische Requisiten etc. bei den Juden, 1870, i. 145 ff.
